# motrack - tools for Multiple Object Tracking

[Multiple Object
Tracking](http://www.scholarpedia.org/article/Multiple_object_tracking)
is a popular experimental paradigm used in visual attention research.
Your goal is to remember several objects and keep track of the them
while they move ([demo](https://youtu.be/lAQM4QJRYV8)).

This package allows researcher to generate object trajectories,
visualize them and export them for experiments. The trajectory and
position data are in `tibble` format for easy further manipulation.

## Installation

The package is in active development. You can install the current
version from GitHub with following code:

``` r

# Install devtools package if necessary
if(!"devtools" %in% rownames(installed.packages())) install.packages("devtools")

# Install the stable verion from GitHub
devtools::install_github("visionlabels/motrack")
```

## Example

Let us create a trajectory or two:

``` r

library(motrack) #load the package

# we want objects starting 
# more further from the arena border and further from each other
sett_generate <-
  new_settings(xlim = c(-7, 7), ylim = c(-7, 7), min_distance = 2,
               arena_shape = "circle")
# they can move in a circular arena, bounce off borders and other objects
sett_move <-
  new_settings(speed = 5, xlim = c(-9, 9), ylim = c(-9, 9),
               bounce_off_square = F,
               bounce_off_circle = T, circle_bounce_jitter = pi / 6)
# here you can separately adjust settings for visualization
sett_show <-
  new_settings(show_labels = T)

# set seed for replicability
set.seed(1001)

position <- generate_positions_random(8, sett_generate)

# our starting positions
plot_position(position, sett_move)

# Make objects move for 8 seconds (0 to 8), adjust direction every 100 ms
timescale <- seq(0, 8, by = 0.1)

# Objects only bounce
trajectory_d <- 
  make_random_trajectory(position, timescale, sett_move, 
    step_direct)

# Object change direction randomly every 0.5-1.5 seconds
trajectory_z <- 
  make_random_trajectory(position, timescale, sett_move, 
    step_zigzag, ttt = c(.5, 1.5), syncstart = F)

# Object change direction smoothly
trajectory_v <- 
  make_random_trajectory(position, timescale, sett_move, 
    step_vonmises, kappa = 10)

plot_trajectory(trajectory_d, sett_show)
plot_trajectory(trajectory_z, sett_show)
plot_trajectory(trajectory_v, sett_show)

# It is possible to implement complex motion patterns:
# Object move for 0.5-1.5 seconds or wait for 0.2-0.5 seconds. 
# After movement/waiting, it waits with probability 0.1, 
# otherwise it changes direction randomly
trajectory_wm <- 
  make_random_trajectory(
    position, timescale, sett_move, 
    step_waitandmove, move_time = c(.5, 1.5), 
    wait_time = c(.2,.5), wait_prob = 0.1, syncstart = F)

# It is possible to vary speed during the trial based on the custom function
f1 <- function(time, moment) {
  5 + cos(time + moment$object) # different offset for each object
}
sett_move$speed <- c(f1)

trajectory_s <- 
  make_random_trajectory(
    position, timescale, sett_move, step_direct)
```

If you have `ffmpeg` installed, you can use `animation` package to
render videos.

``` r

animation::ani.options(ffmpeg = "/usr/bin/ffmpeg")   # update to your path

render_trajectory_video("trajectory_d.mp4", trajectory_d, 
  new_settings(show_labels = T), targets = 1:4
)
render_trajectory_video("trajectory_z.mp4", trajectory_z, 
  new_settings(show_labels = T), targets = 1:4
)
render_trajectory_video("trajectory_v.mp4", trajectory_v, 
  new_settings(show_labels = T), targets = 1:4
)

# variable speed example
render_trajectory_video("trajectory_s.mp4", trajectory_s, 
  new_settings(show_labels = T), targets = 1:4
)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`add_random_direction()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/add_random_direction.md)
  : Add random direction
- [`annotate_aperture()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/annotate_aperture.md)
  : Draw bitmap image as ggplot2 annotation and cover rest with filled
  colour
- [`annotate_image()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/annotate_image.md)
  : Draw bitmap image as ggplot2 annotation
- [`bounce_off_circle()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/bounce_off_circle.md)
  : Check for circular arena bouncing and recalculate directions
- [`bounce_off_inside()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/bounce_off_inside.md)
  : Check for bouncing off the inner circle of a donut arena
- [`bounce_off_others()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/bounce_off_others.md)
  : Check for inter-object bouncing and recalculate directions
- [`bounce_off_square()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/bounce_off_square.md)
  : Check for square-arena bouncing and recalculate directions
- [`bounce_pair()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/bounce_pair.md)
  : Calculate collision vectors for two objects
- [`coords_to_vortex_coords()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/coords_to_vortex_coords.md)
  : Calculate small vortex positions
- [`cur_speed()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/cur_speed.md)
  : Get current speed
- [`default_settings()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/default_settings.md)
  : Default settings for position/trajectory code
- [`extrapolate_moment()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/extrapolate_moment.md)
  : Extrapolates object positions based on current state and time
- [`generate_positions_grid()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/generate_positions_grid.md)
  : Generate grid-arranged positions
- [`generate_positions_random()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/generate_positions_random.md)
  : Random object positions
- [`is_distance_at_least()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/is_distance_at_least.md)
  : Tests inter-object distances
- [`is_valid_position()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/is_valid_position.md)
  : Is the object a valid position
- [`is_valid_trajectory()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/is_valid_trajectory.md)
  : Is the object a valid trajectory
- [`load_trajectory()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/load_trajectory.md)
  : Load trajectory from file
- [`make_random_trajectory()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/make_random_trajectory.md)
  : Create random trajectory
- [`new_settings()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/new_settings.md)
  : Creates a custom copy of settings
- [`plot_position()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/plot_position.md)
  : Plot object positions
- [`plot_trajectory()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/plot_trajectory.md)
  : Plot object trajectories
- [`position8c`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/position8c.md)
  : Example position
- [`render_trajectory_video()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/render_trajectory_video.md)
  : Render video from trajectory
- [`save_trajectory()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/save_trajectory.md)
  : Save trajectory to file
- [`simplify_trajectory()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/simplify_trajectory.md)
  : Simplify trajectory
- [`step_direct()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/step_direct.md)
  : Simple trajectory step function
- [`step_vonmises()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/step_vonmises.md)
  : Von Mises trajectory step function
- [`step_waitandmove()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/step_waitandmove.md)
  : Wait and move step function
- [`step_zigzag()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/step_zigzag.md)
  : Zigzag trajectory step function
- [`trajectory8c`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/trajectory8c.md)
  : Example trajectory
- [`validate_object_direction_change()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/validate_object_direction_change.md)
  : Check direction changes for single object trajectory
- [`validate_trajectory()`](https://visionlabels.github.io/motrack/reference/validate_trajectory.md)
  : Sanity check for trajectory
